title: Road-Toll Surcharge Recovery App
outcome: Per-customer toll impact, a defensible surcharge and the right approver in one screen.
summary: A new per-kilometre HGV toll hits every customer contract at once, and commercial teams need each customer's impact and an approved surcharge fast. Built a tested toll model, a Power Apps surcharge screen with margin effect, a tiered Power Automate approval and a Power BI steering dashboard.
cv: Inspired by: quantified the commercial impact of the Dutch road-freight toll across more than 400,000 annual shipments and 2,400 customers, and built the customer surcharge recovery model and executive dashboard for the Commercial Steering Committee.

cards.title: Surcharge proposal and approval
cards.caption: Pick a customer, choose flat, % of freight or per km recovery, see the margin effect and submit. The approval card shows the correct tier and route. Synthetic data, illustrative rates.
cards.alt: Power Apps style screen with customer list, surcharge proposal, margin bars and an approval card for the steering committee

cards.title: Architecture
cards.caption: Dataverse holds customers, shipments, lanes, toll rates and proposals. A Python model writes toll per shipment; Power Apps, Power Automate, Teams and Power BI do the rest.
cards.alt: Architecture diagram from shipment data and toll rates through Dataverse to Power Apps, Power Automate, Teams and Power BI

cards.title: The toll formula
cards.caption: Toll per shipment is tolled km x rate by CO2 and weight class x share of the truck. Excerpt from src/toll.py.

cards.title: Tier logic in Power Fx
cards.caption: The same thresholds drive the app, the approval flow and the Copilot answer. Excerpt from power-apps/formulas.md.
cards.code:
ApprovalTier(incPct: Number, eur: Number): Text =
    If(incPct <= TierAutoMaxPct && eur <= TierAutoMaxEur, "Auto-approved",
       incPct <= TierCmMaxPct && eur <= TierCmMaxEur, "Commercial manager",
       "Steering committee");

cards.title: On the synthetic dataset
cards.caption: 2,000 shipments, 40 customers, illustrative rates. Computed by toll.py and matched to the cent by the JS demo.

cards.title: Steering dashboard
cards.caption: KPI tiles, a hand-built SVG chart of the top 10 customers by toll impact and proposals by tier, mirroring the Power BI report.
cards.alt: Dashboard tab with KPI tiles and a bar chart of the top 10 customers by toll impact

cards.title: GitHub Copilot ready
cards.caption: Code drafted with AI pair programming and verified by 20 pytest tests and a Python to JavaScript parity check. The repo ships GitHub Copilot custom instructions (brand, British English, synthetic data only, tests first), so every follow-up change in Copilot Chat or agent mode works to the same rules.

cards.title: Try it
cards.caption: Open the simulated app: pick a customer, change the recovery method, submit for approval and ask the Copilot panel to explain the impact.
